literal: Even when commanded he does not do, himself he does not understand; that life, until the limit it departs, is a disease.
translation: He will not do what he is instructed to do, nor does he know what to do on his own. Such a life is a disease to the world until the moment it departs.
modern: ஒருவர் அறிவுறுத்தினாலும் செய்யமாட்டான்; தானாகவும் உணர்ந்து கொள்ளமாட்டான்; அவனுடைய உயிர் உடம்பை விட்டுப் போகும் வரை உலகிற்கு ஒரு நோயாகும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the height of ignorance (புல்லறிவாண்மை). A foolish person is one who neither listens to the wise advice of others nor possesses the self-awareness to act correctly on their own. The poet compares such an individual's very existence to a lingering disease. Until the day that person's life departs from their body, they remain a constant affliction and burden to those around them.
